name: kc-web
description: KiloCenter MIOTY Service Center — web management interface
author: Tim Kravchunovsky

scripts.grpc:setup: mkdir -p node_modules/@kilocenter/grpc-stubs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),d='node_modules/@kilocenter/grpc-stubs',s='src/services/grpc';['identity_pb.js','identity_pb.d.ts','core_pb.js','core_pb.d.ts','identity_pb_service.js','identity_pb_service.d.ts','core_pb_service.js','core_pb_service.d.ts','kilocenter_pb_service.js','kilocenter_pb_service.d.ts','package.json'].forEach(f=>{try{fs.copyFileSync(s+'/'+f,d+'/'+f)}catch(e){console.warn('skip',f)}});fs.writeFileSync(d+'/kilocenter_pb.js','var i=require(\"./identity_pb\");var c=require(\"./core_pb\");Object.keys(i).forEach(function(k){module.exports[k]=i[k]});Object.keys(c).forEach(function(k){module.exports[k]=c[k]});');fs.writeFileSync(d+'/kilocenter_pb.d.ts','export * from \"./identity_pb\";\nexport * from \"./core_pb\";\n')"
scripts.grpc:sync: bun run grpc:generate && bun run grpc:setup
scripts.grpc:verify: TMPD=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$TMPD"' EXIT && mkdir -p $TMPD && grpc_tools_node_protoc --js_out=import_style=commonjs,binary:$TMPD --grpc_out=grpc_js:$TMPD --plugin=protoc-gen-grpc=node_modules/.bin/grpc_tools_node_protoc_plugin --plugin=protoc-gen-ts=node_modules/.bin/protoc-gen-ts --ts_out=service=grpc-web:$TMPD -I ../KC-Core/api/proto -I /usr/local/include ../KC-Core/api/proto/core.proto ../KC-Core/api/proto/identity.proto ../KC-Core/api/proto/kilocenter.proto && rm -f $TMPD/*_grpc_pb.js && for f in core_pb.js core_pb.d.ts core_pb_service.js core_pb_service.d.ts identity_pb.js identity_pb.d.ts identity_pb_service.js identity_pb_service.d.ts kilocenter_pb_service.js kilocenter_pb_service.d.ts kilocenter_pb.js kilocenter_pb.d.ts; do cmp -s "src/services/grpc/$f" "$TMPD/$f" || exit 1; done
